newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Chile's Celulosa set to buy Alto Parana - paper.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Celulosa set to buy Alto Parana - paper.

text.p: Chile's Celulosa Arauco y Constitucion will later Tuesday sign an agreement to buy a controlling stake in Argentina's Alto Parana pulp maker for about $470 million, La Nacion newspaper reported.
It said Celulosa would pay $250 million in cash and assume $220 million in Alto Parana debt.
Celulosa, controlled by the Angelini group, will sign the agreement in New York, La Nacion said.
Alto Parana was put up for sale earlier this year by Citicorp and a group of local banks which control the majority of its shares.
Alto Parana's plant in northern Posadas province produces 260,000 tonnes a year of pulp, mostly for export.
